text:
maya: Quick heads-up — customers reporting mixed signals: SDK returns 429 with `retry_after`, but Console shows a yellow 'degraded' banner and a 503 badge. Users get confused whether to backoff or retry immediately.

sam: Hmm. Are they hitting tenant-level quota or route-level burst? Different layers currently surface different codes.

maya: From the traces I saw it's quota gating at the router (burst queue) that falls back to a cheaper model, then later the route rejects. So two distinct events in one user flow.

cheng: That's the crux — we emit both `quota.block` and `route.degrade` telemetry events. SDK currently maps `quota.block` -> 429, `route.degrade` -> 200 w/ warning meta. But the console badge logic looks only at last route state and shows 503 when degrade->reject happens.

julia: From a product POV we need one clear story for customers: "temporary capacity issue, try again" vs "permanent quota exceeded, contact sales". The wording and the status code should hint at which one.

devx-leo: Agree. SDK owners asked for deterministic mapping: retryable vs non-retryable. Could we standardize on three outward classes: RETRY_NOW (429 + Retry-After), RETRY_LATER (202/409 with hint), and HARD_FAIL (403/402)?

sam: I like bucketization but keep HTTP semantics. 429 -> transient rate quota, 503 -> infra overload, 403 -> quota/account. We should avoid using 200 for warnings; that hides failure surfaces.

maya: If we change the SDK mapping, we also need to update console badges + runbooks. Right now console shows "degraded" (yellow) for any degrade event and uses 503 badge when the route finally rejects. Users see both — confusing.

cheng: Proposal for telemetry + headers: always emit `x-rd-status` with canonical token `status=retryable|degraded|hard-fail;source=router|model|quota;retry_after=30` and keep HTTP code aligned to the most actionable state. Eg: when quota blocks -> 429 + header status=retryable. When router overloaded but we fall back -> 200 + header status=degraded (but SDK should surface as 503 to caller?)

julia: That last bit worries me — the network response should match what customers expect. If we return 200 but include status=degraded, many SDKs will ignore it. We should favor non-2xx when the client needs to act.

devx-leo: Exactly. SDKs prefer code-first signals. Let's keep 2xx only for success semantics. For degradations that materially change output (fallback model) we should return 206/503 depending on severity, plus the header.

sam: Concrete mapping suggestion:
```
- quota.block -> 429, x-rd-status=status=retryable;source=quota;retry_after=<s>
- router.fallback -> 206, x-rd-status=status=degraded;source=router
- router.reject -> 503, x-rd-status=status=hard-fail;source=router
- account.block -> 403, x-rd-status=status=hard-fail;source=quota
```

maya: +1 to that. Also add a small badge rule: Console badge = derived from the highest-severity event in the request window (hard-fail > degraded > retryable). That way UI shows the single dominant state.

cheng: I'll add a telemetry event rename so alerting is simpler: `rd.failure_severity` with labels `severity=hard,degraded,retryable` and `bucket=quota/router/model`. That will make dashboards and runbooks consistent.

julia: UX copy: For retryable -> "Temporary capacity limit. Please retry after {n}s or implement exponential backoff." For degraded -> "We served a lower-capacity model to keep latency. Expect lower fidelity." For hard-fail -> "Request blocked due to account limits or service outage. See runbook." I'll paste exact strings into the console copy repo after we agree.

devx-leo: SDK change list: map HTTP codes as proposed, expose `rdStatus` structured object from headers, and add a high-level boolean `shouldRetry` that's true only for `retryable`. We should bump minor version and publish migration notes.

maya: Ops note — rollout plan: feature-flag telemetry + headers first (no behavior change), flip SDK mapping behind flag for a week, then enable console badge derivation and roll out runbook links. Any objections?

sam: No objections. Need a small integration test to simulate sequences (fallback then reject) and confirm badge derives from highest severity.

cheng: I'll open a tiny RFC and include the header schema and telemetry labels, plus the Prometheus/ES mappings for alerting.

julia: I'll update console copy + runbook templates in a follow-up PR.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline: telemetry-headers-flag -> staging 05:30 UTC tomorrow, prod rollout scheduled 24h after green. :white_check_mark:

maya: Great — can we add one more thing: quick sample for SDK docs showing handling pattern? e.g.:
```
if (resp.statusCode === 429) {
  wait(resp.headers['retry-after']);
} else if (resp.headers['x-rd-status']?.includes('degraded')) {
  showBanner('Lower fidelity served.');
}
```

devx-leo: Will add sample + code snippet in SDK repo. I'll tag you when PR is up, @maya.

maya: Thanks all. I'll file the follow-up RFC link here when cheng creates it. :thumbsup:
